description: Collaboration suites often explain pricing through workflow features, workspace limits, and shared access boundaries rather than just a raw plan price.
Support pages frequently close the loop on plan choice by clarifying free-plan behavior, billing models, or enterprise controls that the pricing page leaves open.
Enterprise and nonprofit paths are often surfaced alongside self-serve pricing, giving users a clearer transition from generic comparison to eligibility-based or admin-managed buying.
transfer_conditions: organizations with special pricing or admin controls
